rulings.restated: Enter the amount from eic helper "Earned income credit for Form 1040, line 27a (Worksheet A, line 6 when Steps 1 to 5 are passed; zero otherwise)".
rulings.model: The SSN and age tests check only the filer. The IRS asks 'Do you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have a social security number...' and 'Were you, or your spouse if filing a joint return, at least age 25 but under age 65', so a joint return can get a different result.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The spouse variants of the SSN and age tests ('and your spouse if filing a joint return') arise only on a joint return, and married filing statuses are refused (s3.married); within scope the filer's own tests are the tests.
